fit: six-month modified Mediterranean diet with olive oil and registered constipation
assessment: The protocol includes raw olive oil in multicomponent dietary advice. It gives no isolated oil arm or assigned grade. The official registry has no posted bowel results.

fit: customary bedtime leaf infusion and reported insomnia use
assessment: Two of 18 stress or insomnia remedy reports name Cymbopogon citratus. The survey reports a bedtime infusion and no insomnia severity comparison.

fit: oral high-oleic sunflower oil comparator and three depression-related scales
assessment: At 26 weeks the sunflower CES-D mean change was −0.4 versus −0.2 and +0.2 under two fish-oil doses, with overall p = .87. Neither refining grade nor an oil-free comparator was verified. This population did not have Parkinson depression.

fit: oral sunflower and fish-oil comparator with standardized depression ratings
assessment: The author Methods identify sunflower oil with 0.2% fish oil. The full-sample adjusted HAM-D difference for EPA versus comparator was −1.5 (95% CI −3.7 to 0.7). Both arms improved. The population had psychological distress and the study did not isolate a refined sunflower effect.

fit: inhaled sunflower carrier in both groups and a reported HADS depression outcome
assessment: Both groups inhaled sunflower carrier and one added lavender. The published within-lavender depression result has p = .025. No numerical between-arm depression effect, trial oil grade or oral exposure was verified.

fit: oral pumpkin seed oil and weekly tail-cuff pressure in hypertensive rats
assessment: At week 8 the oil group was at 134.20 versus 149.40 mmHg in hypertensive controls. The abstract cites a week-5 control. Cold pressing and orthostatic symptoms are unverified, and the Methods describe one oil administration inconsistently.

fit: dried celery leaf powder with thyroid case outcomes
assessment: The case involves 45 days of dried leaf powder and reports thyroid symptoms. Visual hallucination frequency and Parkinson outcomes were unmeasured. Powder cessation coincided with methimazole.

fit: celery extract of unspecified plant part and a thyroid case with blurred vision
assessment: The case separately reports blurred vision during a thyroid presentation. The product is an extract of unspecified plant part, and hallucination frequency was unmeasured. Extract cessation and methimazole began together.
